name: pelayomendez-skills
description: Pelayo Méndez's agent instructions and skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: pelayo-skills
plugins.description: Small skills for running coding agents, and flows that chain them: an always-on reporting style, a permission charter, backlog pruning and ordering, claim checks by a fresh agent, worker briefs, watches and handoffs, a day companion and a night shift built from them, and upkeep for the setup itself.
